I reviewed season-1 and season-2-so-far data plus the day-1 forum posts, and confirmed our current position: at day 32 the fully-unspent budget/PTO/bookings are correct (not a bug), since season-2 trips through doy 0-59 show zero yellowtail on every class and climate (ONI -1.57, PDO -2.04) is still cool/La Niña like at season start — the spring window (doy 70-140) hasn't opened yet. Forum posts from calendarist and fleetwatch independently corroborate our own spring/fall doy-window read and the "half-days are worthless" finding, so I skipped posting (nothing new to add, and it would only invite dilution on the fall day_1_5 boats we're targeting).

**What I changed:** Updated `notes.md` with the day-32 data check-in, and flagged a real issue for next turn — `strategy.py` on disk is still the original placeholder despite day-1 notes claiming it was submitted (no `submit_strategy` tool was even available this turn to fix it), so next planning turn should re-submit and verify it actually took. **Why:** this keeps the nightly self from second-guessing the empty budget/PTO (it's expected, not a failure) while making sure the reflex code gap gets closed before the spring window opens around day ~56-70.
